# Bundled browser libraries

These are the same library versions previously loaded by the tracker from public CDNs. They are saved here so the installed tracker can work offline.

- SheetJS Community Edition 0.18.5: https://github.com/SheetJS/sheetjs (Apache-2.0)
- pdf-lib 1.17.1: https://github.com/Hopding/pdf-lib (MIT)
- @pdf-lib/fontkit 1.1.1: https://github.com/Hopding/fontkit (MIT)

Distribution sources: cdnjs for SheetJS/pdf-lib, and unpkg for @pdf-lib/fontkit. License texts are included alongside the distributions.
